Description: Seagate Game Drive STGG8000400 8 TB external portable hard drive with USB 3.0 in white. A high-capacity storage upgrade with an integrated USB hub for your Xbox One. Key features include a massive 8 TB capacity, enough for 200+ Xbox One games; integrated dual front-facing USB 3.0 ports for charging controllers and mobile devices or connecting other Xbox One accessories; and design and testing in collaboration with Xbox for seamless use with any generation of Xbox One. High-speed USB 3.0 connectivity provides full gaming performance, comparable to playing from the console’s internal hard drive. Setup is fast and simple with no tools required: when connected to the USB port, your Xbox One automatically detects the drive and guides you through basic installation. Need to take your game library on the road? Plug it into a friend’s Xbox One console and continue your progress as if you never left home. Compatibility: Microsoft Xbox gaming console, Xbox One, Xbox One S. Seagate Game Drive Hub for Xbox STGG8000400 with dual USB ports offers 8TB of storage, enough for 200+ games. It helps eliminate the need to delete old games and provides extra room for save data and downloadable content. This officially Xbox-licensed storage product includes dual front-facing USB 3.0 ports, plug-and-play setup that gets you playing in seconds, and high-speed USB 3.0 performance.
